description: The report for fieldwork 7-12 November 2024 (Barometrul LIBERTATEA - INSCOP) states it was conducted by INSCOP Research at the request of the daily Libertatea.
notes: The October 2024 report carries the same statement: https://www.inscop.ro/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/23.10.24-Sondaj-INSCOP-LIBERTATEA.-Partea-a-III-a-Alegeri-Parlamentare.pdf

description: The report for fieldwork 11-16 September 2024 states it was conducted by INSCOP Research at the request of the Institutul pentru Libertate și Democrație.
The pollster's January 2024 publication is titled as a survey conducted by INSCOP Research at the request of News.ro.
notes: News.ro also presents the June 2024 parliamentary vote-intention poll as commissioned by News.ro: https://www.news.ro/politic-intern/sondaj-inscop-la-comanda-news-ro-intentia-de-vot-la-alegerile-parlamentare-psd-29-4-pnl-18-9-aur-14-7-64-2-dintre-ce-chestionati-declara-ca-in-mod-sigur-vor-merge-la-vot-1922403002002024070721651040

description: Collaboration partnership between INSCOP Research and The Polling Company (USA) concluded in 2018, per the pollster's website.
Collaboration partnership between INSCOP Research and The Bullfinch Group concluded in 2021, per the pollster's website.
HotNews published the AtlasIntel presidential poll with fieldwork 10-13 April 2025 under the title 'Sondaj AtlasIntel pentru HotNews'.
notes: Counterpart's own publication. HotNews described the 26-28 November 2024 parliamentary poll as 'obtained by HotNews', without naming a client: https://hotnews.ro/ultimul-mare-sondaj-inainte-de-alegerile-parlamentare-de-duminica-surpriza-uriasa-in-varful-ierarhiei-1848186

description: Nicușor Dan published the results of an AtlasIntel presidential poll, per G4Media; the article does not state who commissioned the poll.
notes: Fieldwork 21-24 February 2025 per the Wikipedia index.

description: Digi24 reports a Verifield poll conducted at the request of USR, fieldwork 7-9 October 2024, CATI, n=1,009.
notes: Libertatea (August 2024, citing sources) also reported a Verifield poll done for USR: https://www.libertatea.ro/stiri/sondaj-mircea-geoana-lider-cu-21-marcel-ciolacu-pe-locul-al-doilea-cu-172-elena-lasconi-scor-dublu-fata-de-nicolae-ciuca-4999965

description: Libertatea reports a Verifield poll commissioned by the team of presidential candidate Crin Antonescu, fieldwork 14-18 February 2025.
Libertatea reports a Verifield poll conducted at the request of Nicușor Dan and published by him on Facebook.
notes: Fieldwork 24-28 March 2025 per the Wikipedia index. Romanian Wikipedia also lists Nicușor Dan as sponsor of a 6 May 2025 Verifield poll; the PDF (https://hotnews.ro/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Raport-ND13-6-Mai-Val-1.pdf) does not name a sponsor in its text layer, so that poll is not recorded here.

description: România TV states that the Sociopol poll with fieldwork 14-17 April 2025 was conducted at the request of România TV.
notes: Counterpart's own publication. Adevărul describes a March 2025 Sociopol poll as done for RTV (https://adevarul.ro/politica/candidatii-cu-cele-mai-mari-sansa-sa-ajunga-in-2430788.html); the indexes list România TV as sponsor of most Sociopol polls of January-May 2025.

description: Adevărul states that Sociopol is coordinated by Mirel Palada, a former spokesperson of the Ponta government.
notes: Victor Ponta was a candidate in pres-2025-r1.

description: Antena 3 CNN states that the ARA Public Opinion poll with fieldwork 18-25 March 2025 was conducted at its request.
notes: Counterpart's own publication. The indexes list Antena 3 CNN as sponsor of the ARA polls of March-April 2025.

description: G4Media (citing News.ro) reports a European Parliament vote-intention poll conducted by CIRA at the request of PNL in December 2023.
notes: Listed in the Romanian Wikipedia parliamentary table under the label 'PNL'.

description: B1TV reports a poll conducted by The Center for International Research and Analyses at the request of the Liberals, with presidential and parliamentary vote intention; the article links the full report.
notes: Fieldwork 24-30 August 2024 per the English Wikipedia index.

description: Newsweek România states that the CIRA poll with fieldwork 9-13 November 2024 was conducted at its request.
notes: Counterpart's own publication. The Wikipedia indexes label this poll 'Newsweek'.

description: The pollster's website lists national political barometers with fieldwork 24-28 October 2024 and 7-10 November 2024 as conducted at the request of Newsweek.
notes: Newsweek România's own article on the October poll: https://web.archive.org/web/20241029172042/https://newsweek.ro/politica/exclusiv-sondaj-ciolacu-si-ciuca-in-turul-2-psd-31-pnl-205-cat-iau-simion-geoana-si-lasconi. The Wikipedia indexes label the October poll 'Newsweek'.

description: A press release published by Oficiul de Știri states that the poll with fieldwork 3-8 January 2024 was conducted by Snap Market Research Plc at the request of Asociația Adevăr și Dreptate.
notes: The same association is named as client of the 25-30 November 2023 poll: https://oficiuldestiri.ro/sondaj-la-comanda-asociatiei-adevar-si-dreptate-usr-scade-puternic-aur-bsr-si-sos-cumuleaza-29/

description: Libertatea describes sociologist Marius Pieleanu as the person who owns the Avangarde institute.
notes: The same article quotes him stating that the March 2025 poll was self-funded.
